F-M7-02_immutable_image_identity.fix: resolve_image_id() resolved immediately before EVERY docker run; argv uses the sha256 ID (never the tag); submission-time IDs re-verified at run start; fail-closed IMAGE_ID_CHANGED / IMAGE_ID_UNAVAILABLE; applies to analysis, C build/run, demo-link, debug, OptimizationLab, benchmarks

evidence: print-different-line-per-repeat workload returning None: checksums_identical=False (5 distinct checksums)
stable-output workload returning 41+1: checksums_identical=True, checksum_includes recorded
raising main(): exception_repeats==['ValueError']*5, consistent checksums (same failure = equivalent)

F-M7-04_safe_previews.evidence: list subclass with side-effecting __len__, one whose __len__ raises, and a str subclass whose __repr__ raises: run COMPLETED, user_len_calls 0, traced frames intact

reproduced_environment_facts: WSL 3.0.3.0 tears down wsl.exe session process trees: plain nohup/setsid daemons die with the launcher; setsid -f double-fork survives (verified)
wsl.exe WITHOUT -e re-wraps the command in the login shell and strips quoting (empty $!); all launcher WSL calls use wsl -e
Windows-side directory caching on /mnt/e (9P) can hide fresh pid files; launcher polls through WSL
a vite listener's process group is its npm leader's pid, not its own; Stop reads the real pgid from /proc/<pid>/stat

in_scope_regression_found_and_fixed_duri.issue: framed-channel trace deadlock + event amplification: CPython fires trace events for frames created while the tracer runs (emit -> json.dumps), and the harness's own traceback/linecache/re bookkeeping was traced; a module-level ZeroDivisionError flooded 5000+ events and deadlocked the channel writer (container SIGKILLed, exit 137, ERR-RUNTIME + adversarial fixtures failed)
in_scope_regression_found_and_fixed_duri.fix: tracer re-entrancy guard + harness-globals frame skip; tracing ends the moment exec returns/raises; channel writes are non-blocking with honest drop accounting (channel_frames_dropped in meta; drops force integrity SUSPECT)
in_scope_regression_found_and_fixed_duri.verification: err_runtime fixture: 17 events, honest ZeroDivisionError exception event, exit 0, meta complete
in_scope_regression_found_and_fixed_duri.second_defect: run_capped pump lambdas hardcoded STDOUT_CAP, ignoring the stdout_cap parameter - framed streams were cut at 1 MB; wired through, both affected tests green
